newsitem.title: USA: Children's Wonderland posts FY96 shr loss.
newsitem.headline: Children's Wonderland posts FY96 shr loss.

text.p: Children's Wonderland Inc said Friday its net loss for the fiscal year ended June 30, 1996, was $2,757,811 or $2.03 a share, 48 percent greater than the year-ago loss.
The company said revenues for the fiscal year were $4,606,319, an increase of 26 percent from the prior fiscal year.
The company said in a statement its growth in revenues was driven by the addition of new centers.

The firm said the net operating loss was due to the initial investment and start-up costs including payroll, staffing, depreciation and amortization of expenses related to new facilities and equipment, associated with the launch of the new centers in California and Colorado.
The company went public in May.
